user.title: Smartschool BE
user.description: Set up your Smartschool account. The date of birth is used for automatic account verification required by Smartschool.

data.totp_code: 2FA code (6 digits from your authenticator app)

data_description.totp_secret: Leave empty when you use the 6-digit code. With your authenticator's secret key (not the 6 digits) Home Assistant makes codes itself and never asks for one again.
data_description.totp_code: Only needed when your school asks for two-factor authentication. Type the code currently shown in your app (e.g. LastPass or Google Authenticator). Home Assistant then keeps the session, so you don't need a code every time.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with Smartschool
reauth_confirm.description: Smartschool asks for a new 2FA code for {username}, or rejected the stored credentials. Usually the 6-digit code from your authenticator app is enough; leave the password empty to keep the stored one.

data.totp_code: 2FA code (6 digits from your authenticator app)

data_description.totp_secret: Leave empty when you use the 6-digit code. With your authenticator's secret key (not the 6 digits) Home Assistant makes codes itself and never asks for one again.
data_description.totp_code: Only needed when your school asks for two-factor authentication. Type the code currently shown in your app (e.g. LastPass or Google Authenticator). Home Assistant then keeps the session, so you don't need a code every time.

error.invalid_base_url: Invalid URL (must start with http:// or https://)
error.invalid_birthday: Invalid date of birth (use format YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2010-03-15)
error.invalid_totp_secret: Invalid 2FA key: it should be at least 16 characters of A-Z and 2-7 (an otpauth:// link is fine too). Mind O vs 0 and I vs 1.
error.totp_required: Your school asks for two-factor authentication: enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
error.totp_failed: Smartschool rejected the code. It changes every 30 seconds: enter the code shown in your app right now and try again.
error.totp_looks_like_code: This is the 6-digit code that changes every 30 seconds. Enter the secret letter code Smartschool shows when you set up the authenticator app.
